methodology: Snow risk uses official NBM Core 1-hour ASNOW exceedance probabilities. KRNO plow/treatment operations begin at trace/light snow. Thresholds are >0.10, >0.50, >1.00, and >2.00 inches in 1 hour, mapped to impact levels 2 through 5. Each threshold probability is passed through the probability x impact risk matrix. If all probabilities are zero, selected risk is None.
